summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a $50,000 monthly extension deposit on August 22, 2026 that pushed its business-combination deadline from August 22 to September 22, 2026, with the target WISeSat.Space Corp. covering half the fee. The charter permits monthly extensions up to January 22, 2027 at $50,000 each. The filing also references an unsecured promissory note issued August 30, 2026 and unregistered equity sales. Watch the extension cadence and note terms against trust cash as the January 2027 outside date approaches.
